verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection gateway, so a background-automation capability is a fair question for it. The pack only shows Triggers, which proxy event subscriptions to MCP servers that then POST events directly to the consumer. That is a developer building block for event delivery, not a Smithery feature for setting up autonomous background automations or recurring schedules. No evidence shows Smithery itself running or scheduling automated workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
